queries: Remote Labor Index 2.5% 2025 physical tasks benchmark

sources_considered.why: Original dated announcement reports the maximum completion rate and explains the unit being measured.
Original paper supplies selection criteria and limitations.
A changing leaderboard is less suitable than the original report for assessing what the referenced study found.

evidence_items.explanation: Supports the reported maximum for the original benchmark. The announcement describes complete freelance projects, so it does not establish a 2.5% rate across all human tasks.

evidence_items.publisher: Center for AI Safety and Scale AI / arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Appendix C.2, Project sourcing criteria, item 1
evidence_items.explanation: Confirms exclusion of physical labor. The paper also excludes some remote work and does not supply a weighted estimate for all human tasks; the size of Marcus's proposed adjustment is therefore unmeasured.

unresolved_gaps: No representative denominator or task weighting connects the benchmark to all human tasks.
No comparable measurement establishes how much including physical labor would lower an overall completion rate.
The claim supplies no threshold for 'massive'.
